item.title: Trump quips about Pearl Harbor when asked if Japan given advanced notice on Iran attacks: 'Wanted surprise'
item.summary: During White House meeting with Japan PM Sanae Takaichi, President Donald Trump quips about Pearl Harbor while speaking about the launch of Operation Epic Fury.

item.title: Judge rips into teen’s ‘high-risk’ behavior before delivering decades-long sentence in violent robbery
item.summary: A Texas judge delivered harsh words while sentencing 18-year-old Caden Fontenette to 25 years for a violent convenience store robbery that terrorized a worker.

item.title: Mystery drones fly near DC-area military base as Iran tensions escalate
item.summary: Unidentified drones reportedly detected near Fort McNair military base in Washington D.C., where top officials reportedly have been housed, sparking security concerns.

item.title: Schumer keeps public guessing on how long Dems will refuse to fund DHS amid terror attacks
item.summary: Schumer declined to answer questions over how long Democrats would continue to hold DHS closed over demands for reforming ICE, even as concerns about terrorism have climbed in recent weeks.

item.title: Far-left podcaster Jennifer Welch claims GOP support of military is 'performative'
item.summary: Podcast host Jennifer Welch criticized Trump and the GOP over military support, raising concerns about U.S. troops and potential escalation with Iran.

item.title: Jack Keane calls out NATO's weakness as shipping crisis grips Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: Retired Gen. Jack Keane slams NATO allies for the initial lack of support in Iran conflict, citing decades of defense budget cuts for social programs on "Hannity."

item.title: Neither the US nor Israel will 'succeed in replacing the Iranian regime,' retired US general says
item.summary: Retired U.S. Lt. Gen. Mark Schwartz told an Israeli newspaper that he believes "neither Israel nor the U.S. will fully succeed in replacing the Iranian regime."

item.title: The NCAA learned a lesson with SMU: Don't trust teams with injury reports, as BJ Edwards saga proved
item.summary: Outrage erupts after SMU’s B.J. Edwards missed the Miami (OH) game. Questions grow over whether the NCAA was misled before Selection Sunday.

item.title: Slotkin presses DHS pick on ICE at polls, says she can’t trust Trump to allow ‘free and fair’ election
item.summary: Sen. Slotkin challenges Trump's DHS pick Mullin over ICE at polling places during confirmation hearing, warning Trump could try to "steal" the 2026 election.

item.title: Country star Zac Brown warns ‘poverty of spirit’ and lack of struggle are ruining American kids
item.summary: Country music star Zac Brown reflected on his tough childhood in an interview with Rolling Stone while warning of youth entitlement in America.
